source: Schroder et al., Screening for prostate cancer decreases the risk of developing metastatic disease (ERSPC), Eur Urol 2012;62(5):745-752
comparison: Invitation to PSA screening vs no invitation, 4 ERSPC centers, men 55-69

metastatic_avoided_per_1000.ref: abstract: absolute risk reduction of metastatic disease 3.1 per 1000 men randomized (0.31%)

relative_reduction_pct.ref: abstract: HR 0.70 (95% CI 0.60-0.82), intention to screen

note: The abstract also prints cumulative incidences of 0.67% and 0.86%, which differ by about 1.9 per 1,000; the stated 3.1 per 1,000 matches the raw counts (256/36,270 vs 410/40,543). We show the stated absolute risk reduction.
